import { env, stdout } from "node:process";
import { query, type Options } from "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk";

const options: Options = {
  mcpServers: {
    inflect: {
      type: "http",
      url: "https://inflect.acme.example/api/mcp",
      headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + env.INFLECT_API_KEY },
    },
  },
  allowedTools: [
      "mcp__inflect__list_risks",
      "mcp__inflect__propose_risks",
  ],
  tools: [],
  settingSources: [],
  strictMcpConfig: true,
  permissionMode: "dontAsk",
};

for await (const message of query({ prompt: "Summarise our open risks.", options })) {
  if (message.type === "result") stdout.write(JSON.stringify(message) + "\n");
}
